fisherman.name: Fisherman
fisherman.description: Durable units that tank damage and deal consistent damage to enemies
fisherman.verboseDescription: Fishermen are suited for close to medium-range combats and are the main offence of the team. They generally possess the most destructive power in man-to-man fights and tend to use Reel or Needles as their primary weapon.

spear-bearer.name: Spear Bearer
spear-bearer.description: Long-range units able to deal massive amounts of damage
spear-bearer.verboseDescription: Spear Bearers attack from long distance and snipe the opponent using Spears as their primary weapon. They do not tend to be very powerful in a melee, but are very valuable due to their pinpoint attacking from a distance.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: Disruptive units that excel at applying debuffs, breaking synergy, and compromising the enemy backline
scout.verboseDescription: Scouts move ahead of the group, observe the environment and situation, and aid the Fishermen as secondary offence. They are usually lightly armed for the intention to be agile and swift in movement and thinking.

light-bearer.name: Light Bearer
light-bearer.description: Strategic support units specializing in utility, buffs, and lighthouses
light-bearer.verboseDescription: Lightbearers use Lighthouses to gain information on the battle or the surroundings. They gather information and formulate plans with the help of such information as they command their Lighthouse.

wave-controller.name: Wave Controller
wave-controller.description: Versatile units that manipulate shinsu for area control, damage amplification, and support
wave-controller.verboseDescription: Wave Controllers help their allies in battle by attacking the enemy or aiding the team by manipulating Shinsu. This position is rare compared to the others and requires an expert and specialized manipulation of Shinsu.

frontline-shinheuh.name: Frontline Shinheuh
frontline-shinheuh.description: Special units summoned by Anima to fight on their behalf
frontline-shinheuh.verboseDescription: Shinheuh are creatures native to the tower. Some people called Anima are able to subjugate and control these beasts to do their bidding. Shinheuh species are incredibly varied, and so their play style is determind by the creature itself and not their position.

backline-shinheuh.name: Backline Shinheuh
backline-shinheuh.description: Special units summoned by Anima to fight on their behalf
backline-shinheuh.verboseDescription: Shinheuh are creatures native to the tower. Some people called Anima are able to subjugate and control these beasts to do their bidding. Shinheuh species are incredibly varied, and so their play style is determind by the creature itself and not their position.

landmark.name: Landmark
landmark.description: Special units that apply continuous effects to the entire battlefield
landmark.verboseDescription: Landmarks represent notable locations or structures in the tower. Unlike other units they don't attack or take actions, but they apply powerful continuous effects that drastically affect gameplay.
